change: Make participant identity visibly part of the generated workshop PDF while preserving the same submission lineage, private portal intake and authenticated portal claim.
root_cause: The scan previously persisted only the no-PII aggregate scan event while richer participant/company context remained in browser state and a separate lead route, so a later portal session could lose the data or require re-entry.
prevention_rule: Every consented workshop scan must use one submission_key across stored answers, private intake, generated PDF and portal state. The PDF must visibly show participant name + company context on both pages and use a company+participant filename. The name stays private account/portal context and never enters aggregate benchmark/growth learning.

evidence.privacy: workshop_portal_intakes service-role only; aggregate scan/growth events remain no-PII
